risk_if_not_implemented: Without Alternate Work Site, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Pandemic (Disease) Outbreaks (NT-7); Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Remote Access
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to define, control and review organization-approved, secure remote access methods.
compensating_control_1.justification: Remote Access (NET-26) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Alternate Work Site (PES-05) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Physical & Environmental Protections
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the operation of physical and environmental protection controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Physical & Environmental Protections (PES-02) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Alternate Work Site (PES-05) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
